There's a Fallen Tank storming down the field!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 30 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Tank''' is an enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], [[Challenge Trials]] and Fallen Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a high amount of health and a fast speed, as fast as the [[Corrupted Fallen]]. == Logbook Description == "''Fallen Tanks were siege specialists who broke through enemy lines during the kingdom's golden age. They wore the heaviest armor and were the quickest in their class. When cursed, their bodies fused with their equipment, making them significantly more resilient.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Tank''' is a knight completely covered in grey and blue armor. On its knee-pads, shoulder-pads and belt, it has multiple blue gems. It has chains on its arms. It constantly stumbles on the path as it walks. When killed, the '''Fallen Tank''' will trip and fall on to the ground. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]] and [[Turret]] are recommended to take this enemy down. **The [[DJ Booth]], [[Commander]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to boost these towers. **The [[Necromancer|Necromancer's]] units can also be used to quickly deal with it, though note that this may not be the most consistent counter. *Because of the '''Fallen Tank's''' fast speed, long-ranged towers such as the [[Ranger]] can be a great counter, as it has one of the largest ranges in the game, being able to cover most of the maps. This means that the '''Fallen Tank''' will take more time to get out of its range. **Do be aware that certain maps with a shorter path length, like [[Dead Ahead]] are not suited for long-ranged towers due to the extremely short amount of time that it takes for enemies to reach the base. Because of this flaw paired with the '''Fallen Tank's''' fast speed, you are better off using towers with instant high DPS capabilities. Longer maps such as [[Four Seasons]] adapt better to long-range towers. *Stalling towers, such as the [[Warden]], [[Tesla]], [[Freezer]] or [[Archer]], can be used to slow the '''Fallen Tank''' down, as it is quite fast. **Due to its large size, certain forms of stalling like freeze or knockback will slow it down for a shorter amount of time. **Note that, in the [[Hidden Wave]], this is practically mandatory in order to handle the [[Nimble]] and [[Bloated]] Fallen Tanks that spawn there. For your own sake, bring some form of stalling if you dare to attempt [[Hidden Wave]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenTankRun.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenTankDeath.gif|Death animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenTank.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenTank.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FallenFoesThumbnail.png|'''Fallen Tank''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} FallenTeaser1.jpg|'''Fallen Tank''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Rocketeer Rework - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Tank''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Player VS Player Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Tank''' in the game trailer.
